python - <<'EOF'
import uuid
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

import app.models  # noqa
from app.db import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from app.models.tenant import Tenant
from app.models.user import User

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)
db = Session()

tenant_id = uuid.uuid4()
admin_id = uuid.uuid4()
approver_id = uuid.uuid4()
db.add(Tenant(id=tenant_id, name="Acme", high_risk_threshold=70, created_by=admin_id, updated_by=admin_id))
db.add(User(id=admin_id, tenant_id=tenant_id, name="Admin", email="admin@acme.test", role="TENANT_ADMIN", created_by=admin_id, updated_by=admin_id))
db.add(User(id=approver_id, tenant_id=tenant_id, name="Approver", email="approver@acme.test", role="APPROVER", created_by=admin_id, updated_by=admin_id))
db.commit()

def override():
    yield db
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override
client = TestClient(app)

print("no header:", client.get("/api/v1/esignature-settings").status_code)
print("wrong role:", client.get("/api/v1/esignature-settings", headers={"X-User-Role":"APPROVER","X-User-Id":str(approver_id)}).status_code)
r = client.get("/api/v1/esignature-settings", headers={"X-User-Role":"TENANT_ADMIN","X-User-Id":str(admin_id)})
print("get default:", r.status_code, r.json())
r = client.put("/api/v1/esignature-settings", json={"reminderFrequencyDays": 5, "defaultSignatureProvider": "DocuSign"}, headers={"X-User-Role":"TENANT_ADMIN","X-User-Id":str(admin_id)})
print("put:", r.status_code, r.json())
r = client.put("/api/v1/esignature-settings", json={"reminderFrequencyDays": -1}, headers={"X-User-Role":"TENANT_ADMIN","X-User-Id":str(admin_id)})
print("put invalid:", r.status_code, r.json())
r = client.put("/api/v1/esignature-settings", json={"defaultSignatureProvider": "Fax"}, headers={"X-User-Role":"TENANT_ADMIN","X-User-Id":str(admin_id)})
print("put invalid provider:", r.status_code, r.json())

spec = app.openapi()
paths = spec["paths"]
assert "/api/v1/esignature-settings" in paths
p = paths["/api/v1/esignature-settings"]
print("openapi methods:", list(p.keys()))
sec = spec["components"]["securitySchemes"]
print("security schemes:", list(sec.keys()))
EOF
